chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: The Village Vanguard with Eddie Heywood, and Pearl Bailey as her fill-in
summary: At the Vanguard with Eddie Heywood, she went home for Derby time and found Pearl Bailey to cover. Pearl got her big break at the Blue Angel and also worked briefly for Basie.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Well listen, who did you work with when you went to the Vanguard, who was it? Can you remember.
Oh, he was super-duper, yes indeed. I went down there and I stayed and stayed and it was getting Derby (Kentucky) time. So I had to go home for the Derby, you know.

Yeah. So I told Eddie I was going and I was going to try and find somebody to fill in for me. Well, everybody was working and I couldn't find somebody. Then somebody said, Pearl Bailey ain't doing nothing. I said, where does Pearl live? So they gave me her address and I went down there and I talked with Pearl and I said, "Pearl, would you come on and work down here at the Village Vanguard for me because I'm

going home to the Derby". And I said, "If I don't come back you just stay there because they'll love you". And I went on home and I just stayed at home till I got tired. That's when Pearl got her big break. They took her up to the Blue Angel.
Yeah. And that was her big start and I was glad.
She never looked back from there, did she?
No. She was a talent and she should have gone cause she was good. She worked for Basie for awhile.
Really? I didn't know that. Well, she was a performer.
As opposed to being a singer.
Yeah, well she wasn't the greatest singer but she was a performer.
